global_prohibited_assertions: The study proves causal determinants of employee performance.
P4 or P5 is timestamp-verified prospective validation.
A universally best model or information policy was identified.
Selection-objective sensitivity can be reduced to one binary material-dependence verdict.
A lower-order permutation alone establishes material ranking dependence.
Random Forest's aggregate ordinal scores imply adequate rating-4 detection.
The subgroup analysis proves fairness, discrimination, protected-class effects, or legal compliance.
The HR target formulations are construct-equivalent or their score differences are improvements.
The 311-row versus 309-row HR contrast isolates a refitting effect.
The matched HR target-alias analysis is an equivalence test or robustness certification.
HRDataset_v14 is a locked-model external validation of the INX system.
The literature review establishes a world-first or exhaustive novelty claim.
SHAP values identify causal, actionable, or employee-level prescriptions.
Raw employee-level data are approved for public redistribution.
Ethics approval, exemption, consent waiver, funding, conflicts, or author roles are resolved.
A final tag, GitHub release, archival record, or DOI already exists.
